calibration: Stage13 result frozen; no new knob fitting or error acceptance.
capacitance_scope: Physical harness wire lengths unchanged; wire-only sensitivity unchanged. New package/PCB/loop parasitics and complete effective capacitance UNKNOWN.
load_scope: Recomputed geometry is not resistance or current. Actual copper widths, paths, necks, vias, upstream source and shared return currents remain UNKNOWN; no equal sharing.

resistance_accounting.catalog_contact_scope: Retained GH catalog contact measurement does not automatically include installedcrimp,wire or board solderjoint. Exact measurementplanes required before adding/subtracting terms; avoid doublecounting internal conductor portions.
resistance_accounting.complete_loop: Per-endpoint source-to-pad reachability is not a closed supply/return qualification. Complete upstream hotfeed and returnfeed, sharedreturn topology and source regulation must all be supplied.
resistance_accounting.expression: DeltaVhot=sum(Iedge*Redge); DeltaVreturn=sum(signed Ireturn_edge*Redge), worst-case from declared state envelopes without cancellation credit; source regulation plus hotloss plus returnshift plus transient separately
resistance_accounting.shared_edges: Edge identity reused in multiple endpoint walks is one physical conductor. endpoint_walk_use_count is not current multiplicity; add actual downstream load once.
resistance_accounting.stage11_strap_option: Frozen comparison only; no new geometry/material/contact elaboration and no substitution into baseline graph.
